class.name: PorchlightRule
class.brief_description: Combines a Porchlight condition with an action.
class.description: A reusable rule that evaluates a [PorchlightCondition] and executes a [PorchlightAction] when the condition is met. A rule is valid only when both resources are assigned, the condition contains the milestone data required by its match mode, and the action contains a valid milestone name. Changes made inside the assigned condition or action are propagated through this resource's [signal Resource.changed] signal. Use [PorchlightRuleRunner] or [PorchlightRuleManager] to evaluate rules automatically when milestone progress changes.

method.name: evaluate_and_execute
method.description: Evaluates [member condition] and executes [member action] if the condition is met. Returns [code]true[/code] if executing the action changed persistent milestone state. Returns [code]false[/code] when the rule is disabled, incomplete, the condition is not met, or the action does not change progress. Emits [signal evaluated] after the evaluation attempt.

method.name: get_description
method.description: Returns a readable description of the rule, including its condition and action. Returns a configuration message when the rule is disabled or missing a required resource.

method.name: is_condition_met
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the rule is enabled, a condition is assigned, and that condition is currently met. This method does not execute [member action].

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member condition] and [member action] are assigned and both resources are structurally valid. Condition validity depends on [member PorchlightCondition.match_mode]. Single conditions require [member PorchlightCondition.milestone], while composite conditions require at least one entry in [member PorchlightCondition.milestones]. The value of [member enabled] does not affect structural validity.

members.member: The action executed when [member condition] is met. Changes made inside this resource are propagated through the rule.
The single or composite condition evaluated by this rule. Changes made inside this resource are propagated through the rule.
If [code]false[/code], the condition is treated as unmet and the action is not executed.

signal.name: evaluated
signal.description: Emitted after [method evaluate_and_execute] evaluates the rule. [param condition_met] indicates whether the condition was met. [param action_changed] indicates whether executing the action changed persistent milestone state.
